desc: Implement right-to-left DP storing only C with A/B recomputed on the fly, using min1/min2 exclusion and INF handling.
Implement greedy left-to-right lexicographic reconstruction using A/B/C suffix states.
Execute brute-force checker (exhaustive length 1..4 over 'abc' + random length 5..6 over 'abcd'): PASS 4120/4120, reconstruction length always n.
Performance/memory test for n=5*10^4 (all-'a', all-'z', random): completes within a few seconds, ~5MB, no boundary index errors.
Final submission contains only class Solution (no leftover scaffolding).
